about: Banned claims for the BC Glass & Tint site. lib/validate.js scans every built HTML file (and the CSS bundles for entries that list css) and, in a production build, fails on a hit; in any other build it prints a warning. Seeded 2026-10-29 from the blueprint claims table 6.2 (rows C1 to C20, overhaul-v3/01-BLUEPRINT-psychology.md), engineering 3.2.6, decisions-and-rules.md (windshield replacement is subcontracted, owner nameless, usable claims) and area-profile.md banned_claims and cta_rules. Lift an entry on purpose by editing it here once the owner confirms the claim (for example the film brand), never by editing a page around it.

fields.id: short stable name shown in the failure message
fields.row: blueprint row or rule source, so a future owner confirmation can lift it on purpose
fields.scope: surface = visible text, alt/title/aria-label/placeholder/meta content and JSON-LD (default); meta = the title and meta/og/twitter content only; raw = the whole file source
fields.modes: production = the entry is only checked in a production build
fields.unless: the entry is skipped when this data condition holds: { file: site|pricing, path, nonEmpty } or { file, path, contains }

entries.message: XPEL is an unconfirmed manufacturer affiliation. Remove until the owner confirms the brand and the right to name it (open q_film_supplier).
ASWF is part of the unconfirmed 'XPEL & ASWF Film' chip. Remove until the owner confirms.
Write 'Lifetime manufacturer warranty on the film', never a bare or 'on all films' lifetime warranty (decisions-and-rules usable claims).
Absolute heat outcome. Use 'Helps keep the cabin cooler' (lesson L28).
No heat, cooling or savings percentages (banned_claims). A UV figure is the only percentage allowed.
Absolute outcome. Use 'Helps protect floors and furniture from UV fading'.
Absolute energy outcome. Use 'Can help lower cooling bills' with no number.
Unconfirmed spec claim about subcontracted glass work. Use 'Glass ordered to your VIN'.

entries.pattern: \bonly gets? worse\b|\bstructural role\b|\bstops? it coming back\b
entries.message: Absolute chip or protection outcome. Use 'A chip is easiest to repair before it spreads'.
Unsubstantiated until the owner confirms chips are billed through insurance.
Ads do not advertise mobile service. Write 'For homes and offices we come to you'.
Implies a film choice the site does not offer. Allowed only once pricing.json film_tiers is filled.
Label does not pay off while the price is 'Call for a quote'.
Reads as a measured norm. Use 'Starting prices'.
Unconfirmed reply promise. Allowed only once the owner sets site.json lines.request_confirm to include it.

entries.pattern: \bhosted by that platform\b|\bcounts as of august 2026\b|\bfive-star platforms\b
entries.message: Tint Wiz is BC's own system and the date is stale. Date every count from a live read (lesson L23).
No review count in a title or meta. It freezes with no as-of date (WE #13).
Never headline auto glass or windshield replacement in a title or meta (decisions-and-rules).
Stray space before a comma, semicolon or full stop.
AutoGlassShop is not a schema.org type (404). Use AutomotiveBusiness and HomeAndConstructionBusiness.
Google does not support additionalType on the business node.
No rating or review count in structured data, ever.
No em dash or en dash in anything a client can read.
No 'save' or 'bundle' price language (no was-price, no bundle framing). CEO 2026-10-29: narrowed to price wording; 'save energy' style sentences are not price language.
Past-customer discounts stay in the thank-you emails, not on the site.
Saturday is open, Sunday is not. Never imply weekend or all-week availability.
Never claim BC does windshield replacement labor. Say glass ordered to the VIN, job booked, insurance claim help, finished on the appointment day.
The owner and staff stay nameless on the site (family-owned is fine, named is not).
A production build must never print a draft price.
A production build must never carry draft price data.
No Google brand colors on the site (platform mark rules).
